|-
!
! Non-profit route
! For-profit route

| '''Typical money'''
| Grants, tax-deductible donations
| Customer revenue, services, investment
|-

| A tax-exempt entity, or a fiscal sponsor
| A business entity and customers
|-

<span id="choosing"></span>
== Choosing ==

# Decide whether you want to run a business, or to fund open source work as a public good. The answer picks the route.
# Do the [[Basic business setup|basic business setup]] either way: you need an entity or a sponsor, and a bank account.
# If you take the non-profit route without your own tax-exempt entity, read [[Fiscal sponsorship]] before applying for grants, because many funders only give to tax-exempt organizations.
# If you pursue grants, read [[Grant-writing help]].

<span id="the-collectives-own-funding"></span>
== The collective’s own funding ==

The collective itself takes donations through GoFundMe, GiveSendGo and Buy Me a Coffee (see [[Outbound messaging]]). Whether it will have a legal entity or sponsor is still open (see [[How we are organized]]).
